title: Inherited CETP deficiency
description: A CETP splice-site mutation was linked to CETP deficiency and markedly higher HDL in a family.
evidence_scope: Human genetic effect on CETP and HDL; not coronary-outcome evidence

title: Target suppression lowers lesions
description: Suppressing CETP reduced atherosclerotic lesions in cholesterol-fed rabbits.

title: A CETP inhibitor helps rabbits
description: A different CETP inhibitor improved lipids and attenuated atherosclerosis in rabbits.

title: Torcetrapib raises HDL
description: A short multidose study showed that torcetrapib inhibited CETP and raised HDL in healthy participants.
evidence_scope: Compound-specific early human evidence; publication month

title: ILLUMINATE begins
description: Trial of torcetrapib plus atorvastatin versus atorvastatin in a coronary-risk population.
evidence_scope: Trial record; start date has month precision

title: Development stopped
description: Pfizer announced termination of ILLUMINATE and the compound's development after a mortality and cardiovascular-event imbalance.

title: Higher HDL, more harm
description: Published trial results showed improved lipid levels alongside higher mortality and cardiovascular morbidity.

title: Target or drug effect?
description: CETP genetic variants resembled the drug's lipid effects but not its blood-pressure rise, supporting an off-target explanation of that effect.

title: HDL assumption questioned
description: Some genetic mechanisms raising HDL did not lower heart-attack risk. This challenges HDL elevation as a sufficient rationale; it is not a CETP-specific negative result.
evidence_scope: Related later evidence; not a 2006 prediction

title: Another CETP drug shows benefit
description: REVEAL found fewer major coronary events with anacetrapib, showing that torcetrapib's failure did not invalidate the whole target class.

title: CETP development continues
description: A sponsor update described continued obicetrapib development; this is not a completed cardiovascular-outcome result.

title: ACCELERATE begins
description: Evacetrapib, a CETP inhibitor, entered this large cardiovascular-outcomes study in high-risk vascular disease.
evidence_scope: Trial population is broader than CAD alone

title: Programme discontinued
description: The sponsor stopped the study and development for this indication because the emerging evidence suggested insufficient efficacy.

title: Marker gains, no benefit
description: Despite favorable lipid changes, evacetrapib did not reduce cardiovascular events in ACCELERATE.

title: Look beyond HDL alone
description: CETP/HMGCR genetic analyses related cardiovascular risk changes to apoB changes, refining the target hypothesis.
evidence_scope: Later target-specific context; not proof of why this trial failed
